title: Invalidate retained evaluations when a cited gate is superseded
outcome: Retained evaluation reuse follows native gate supersession semantics across the complete current origin feed.
acceptance: A newer origin-feed record of a gate cited by a passing evaluation makes retained association and current consumption ineligible, including when an older requested cut omits that newer record.
Behavioral tests preserve the eligible control before supersession, refuse after a later failed same-name gate on unchanged source, and preserve unrelated gate behavior and original history.
